requirements.quote: Proposers should be willing and able to provide additional information that may be required by the Authority or its Committee.
requirements.text: Proposers must provide additional information if requested by the Authority or its Committee.

requirements.quote: Also, interviews and office visits may be requested at the discretion of the Authority/Committee.
requirements.text: Proposers must accommodate interviews and office visits if requested.

requirements.quote: Upon review of proposals submitted by Proposers, the Authority/Committee may, at its discretion, submit to Proposers written questions and requests for clarification relating to their Proposals.
requirements.text: Proposers must respond to written questions and requests for clarification from the Authority/Committee.

requirements.quote: Proposers will be provided the period of time in which the written responses to the Authority’s requests for clarification must be completed.
requirements.text: Proposers must submit written responses to clarification requests within the provided timeframe.

requirements.quote: Other than to provide clarifying information as may be requested by the Authority, including the Committee, no Proposer will be allowed to alter its proposal or add information.
requirements.text: Proposers cannot alter or add to their proposal except to provide requested clarifications.

requirements.quote: The Authority/Committee will examine all proposals that are received in a proper and timely manner to determine if they meet the proposal submission requirements, as described in this RFP.
requirements.text: Proposals must be submitted properly and on time to be considered.

requirements.quote: Proposals that are materially deficient in meeting the submission requirements or have omitted material documents, in the sole opinion of the Committee, may be rejected.
requirements.text: Proposals missing required elements or documents may be rejected.

requirements.quote: Proposals failing to pass the Submission Review will be considered non-responsive and will not be evaluated any further.
requirements.text: Non-compliant proposals will not proceed to further evaluation.

requirements.quote: Proposals will be reviewed based on a variety of criteria, including but not limited to:
requirements.text: Proposals will be evaluated based on specified criteria.

requirements.quote: The education, experience and/or expertise of the Proposer and it’s principals and key employees.
requirements.text: Proposer's education, experience, and expertise will be evaluated.

requirements.quote: The Proposer’s specific experience, stability and history of performance providing the requested services similar to those under consideration.
requirements.text: Proposer's experience, stability, and performance history will be evaluated.

requirements.quote: The availability of adequate personnel to provide the requested services safely and efficiently.
requirements.text: Proposer must have sufficient personnel to perform services safely and efficiently.

requirements.quote: The Proposer’s approach to the planning, organization, supervision, and management of the requested services at the Airport, including communications procedures, problem-solving approaches, costing and other level-of-service factors.
requirements.text: Proposer's approach to service management and planning will be evaluated.

requirements.quote: The Proposer’s proposed fee for the services requested herein with a breakdown of those fee’s as they relate to discrete tasks or phases of the work to be performed.
requirements.text: Proposer must provide a detailed fee breakdown for the services.

requirements.quote: Commitment to consistently maintain the highest standards of performance and the expeditious resolution of problems and complaints.
requirements.text: Proposer must commit to high performance standards and quick problem resolution.
